ROI Basics

What is ROI and why does it matter?

ROI, or return on investment, compares what a project earns with what it costs. It matters because it helps you judge whether the money you spend today is likely to create enough value later, and how long it will take to pay back.

Scenario assumptions

Values used in the model

Each saved scenario has its own cost, timing, revenue, and growth assumptions.
